column3: NKJV has “loved us and washed us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “loves us and freed us.”
NKJV has “kings and priests,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “a kingdom, priests.”
NKJV includes “the Beginning and the End” and has “the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks the first phrase and reads “the Lord God.”
NKJV has “kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “kingdom and endurance in Jesus.”
NKJV includes “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last” and “which are in Asia,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “Amen” and has the order “Hades and of Death,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks “Amen” and reads “Death and Hades.”
